tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Shipshape Data's documentation: 222 practical guides on data and AI plus the service and industry pages. Results include the questions each page answers and its URL.

query.description: What you want to know, e.g. "what is data lineage"

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown twin of any shipshapedata.com page (articles, services, industries, case studies). Pass the page URL or path, e.g. "/resources/data-architecture/data-cleaning/".

url.description: Page URL or absolute path on shipshapedata.com

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: The site's sections and resource categories with article counts, for orientation before searching. Pass a category name to list every guide in it.

category.description: Optional: a resource category name (e.g. "Data & architecture") to list its guides
